description: Module diagnostics for the DS4H course (D-23): one 10-question quiz per course module, used by the fast-track rule (score >= fasttrack_min_percent opens the module's Knowledge Checks without its SCORM). Question ids are question bank entry ids in the course's shared bank 'Default for SM&R'. Module 1 reuses the existing Placement Test unchanged. Built by course-setup/build_diagnostics.php.
course: Data Science & Analytics for Public Health (dev course 4, restored without user data). Entry ids are the same in any restore of this course backup; re-check after editing the bank.
